title: Holy Blue Honey
description: Changes all blocks and items related to honey and honeycombs to blue-ish and purple-ish colors
body:
Something that started after a stupid joke in my friendgroup - "синий мёдик"(blue honey)
This joke is a reference to a picture with a story about bees that made blue-colored honey after visiting a M&Ms factory that was nearby. I KNOW I'M STUPID and now i want to share this monstrosity of a texturepack with the world!
